messages:
alice: Heads-up — scheduling a config-only deploy in 10m to tighten per-tenant rate_limit, reduce text-gen max_batch, and enable route backoff for noisy tenants. Canary to 2% for 15m. @ben @carla please watch infra and routing.

deploy-bot: /deploy config-only start by alice — canary=2% for 900s, target_changes=[rate_limit: default 1rps->0.7rps, text-gen.max_batch: 16->8, embeddings.max_batch: 16 (unchanged), route_backoff: enabled]. Trigger id=1769991234

alice: command I ran: ```/deploy config-only --canary 2% --duration 900 --patch "rate_limit.default=0.7,text-gen.max_batch=8,route_backoff=enabled"```

ben: quick question — does this touch kv-cache TTLs or prefix cache warmers? small batches can increase request churn.

alice: kv-cache TTLs unchanged. we'll add a tiny warmup job for new backoff keys (5m prewarm). no model or weights changed.

carla: Monitoring checklist: p50/p95 latency, throttles, redis CPU, request per-second per-tenant. Abort conditions: p95 > 500ms for 5m OR error_rate > 1.5x baseline for 3m. Who's oncall?

sre-oncall: I'm on. I'll handle alerts and have rollback ready. Setting temporary alert thresholds now.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1769991294 — applying config patch to 2% sample group.

sre-oncall: seeing a small throttle bump (1.2x) on text-gen at canary. redis CPU +8%. Holding, do not promote.

ben: sounds like batch shrink caused more frontier calls. Suggest differential batching: keep embeddings at 16, text-gen at 8; consider 12 for long-seq text-gen routes.

alice: good call. I'll patch to make embeddings route explicit and set text-gen.longseq.max_batch=12 for long seq only. Applying small follow-up patch.

deploy-bot: Patch applied at 1769991365 — updates: text-gen.max_batch=8, text-gen.longseq.max_batch=12, embeddings.max_batch=16. Canary remains at 2%.

sre-oncall: metrics trending back toward baseline after longseq adjustment. throttles down to 1.05x and redis CPU stable.

carla: OK — proceed protocol: if stable for next 10m, promote to 10% then 30% staged ramp. Keep runbook: rollback if errors > 1.5x OR sustained p95>500ms.

alice: promoting to 10% now. deploy-bot: increase canary to 10% (staged).

deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 10% at 1769991450.

sre-oncall: watching dashboard — p50/p95 within thresholds, small latency decrease on embeddings route. No action.

alice: rolling notes for release log: "config-only: tightened default rate limits; reduced default text-gen batch size with long-seq exception; enabled route-level backoff for noisy tenants. No model or runtime changes. Warmup job added for backoff keys." Docs: https://go.redwood/infer/release/1769991234

carla: adding rollout guard: automatic rollback if aggregated error_rate > 1.5x baseline OR token_throughput drops > 10% for 5m.

ben: :white_check_mark: thanks everyone. No further action unless alerts fire.

alice: leaving this thread open for the rest of the change window. If we hit rollback conditions I'll post timeline + reason. Otherwise I'll publish final release notes in ~30m. :eyes:
